military.t: 🚨 CENTCOM BLOCKADE BEGINS — Mon 10 AM ET (Apr 13)
military.d: CENTCOM statement: 'will begin implementing a blockade of all maritime traffic entering and exiting Iranian ports on April 13 at 10 AM ET, in accordance with the President's proclamation.' Will be enforced impartially against vessels of all nations entering or departing Iranian ports and coastal areas. Ships going between non-Iranian ports may still transit Hormuz. US also instructed Navy to 'seek and interdict every vessel in International Waters that has paid a toll to Iran.' DOJ AG Blanche: 'will vigorously prosecute anyone who buys or sells sanctioned Iranian oil.'

military.t: 🚨 Iran IRGC Threatens 'Severe Force' Against US Warships
military.d: Iran IRGC Navy: any military vessels approaching Strait of Hormuz 'will be considered a violation of the ceasefire and will be met with a firm and forceful response' (Fars news agency). IRGC also stated Hormuz is under 'smart control and management' and open for non-military vessels under specific regulations — directly contradicting US blockade framing. Iran Deputy Parliament Speaker Nikzad: 'In 40 days of war, US learned determination beats rhetoric on social media.'

military.t: 🔴 Islamabad Talks COLLAPSED — 21 Hours, No Deal
military.d: Most intensive US-Iran engagement since 1979 ended without agreement. Vance: 'bad news — no agreement. Iran chose not to accept our terms. I think that's bad news for Iran much more than it's bad news for the US.' US red lines unmet: end all enrichment, dismantle major facilities, allow retrieval of HEU, stop proxy funding (Hamas/Hezbollah/Houthis), fully open Hormuz without toll. Iran demanded: frozen asset release, sanctions lifted, Hormuz control, right to enrichment, end Israel attacks on Lebanon, war reparations.

military.t: ⚠️ Trump Considers Resuming Military Strikes — WSJ
military.d: Wall Street Journal: Trump considering resumption of limited military strikes on Iran to break stalemate, citing sources. Trump Truth Social: 'At an appropriate moment, we are fully LOCKED AND LOADED, and our Military will finish up the little that is left of Iran.' Trump on Fox: blockade is 'called all in and all out.' Vance left a 'final and best offer.' Analysts warn strikes would end ceasefire and risk full escalation. Ceasefire technically 'holding' per Trump as of Mon morning.

military.t: 🚢 Two US Destroyers Transit Hormuz — First Since War
military.d: USS Frank E. Petersen Jr. (DDG 121) and USS Michael Murphy transited Hormuz Saturday — first US warships since war began. CENTCOM: 'operation focused on freedom of navigation + setting conditions for clearing mines.' Iran claimed one vessel 'turned back after warning' — US did not confirm. Pentagon confirmed mine-clearance operation underway. India's Op Urja Suraksha: 5+ warships standing by in Gulf of Oman.

military.t: 🇬🇧 UK Refuses to Join Blockade — Backs Freedom of Navigation
military.d: UK government confirmed it will NOT assist with the blockade. Spokesperson: 'We continue to support freedom of navigation and the opening of the Strait of Hormuz, which is urgently needed to support the global economy and the cost of living back home.' UK joining coalition of 40+ countries seeking to open strait. Relations between Trump and UK PM Starmer strained. Trump suggested Gulf allies helping — 'they've already started.'

military.t: 🇮🇱🇱🇧 Lebanon-Israel Talks Confirmed for Tuesday in Washington

Lebanon PM on Orthodox Easter: hoped Lebanon would 'overcome dangers, achieve stability, peace and prosperity.' Netanyahu: 'wants real peace agreement with Lebanon, not just a ceasefire.' Israel killed 350+ in Lebanon on Apr 9 (a day after ceasefire with Iran). Lebanon-Israel track continuing independently of Iran talks.

assessment.body:
Day 45 opens as the war's worst single morning for Indian markets since Day 1.

THE COLLAPSE
• After 21 hours of marathon direct talks in Islamabad — first US-Iran face-to-face since 1979 — Vance confirmed no agreement
• Vance: 'The bad news is that we have not reached an agreement. Iran chose not to accept our terms. I think that's bad news for Iran much more than for the US.'
• THE sticking point: Trump Truth Social: 'most points were agreed to, but the only point that really mattered, NUCLEAR, was not.'
• US red lines: end ALL uranium enrichment, dismantle major enrichment facilities, allow US to retrieve Iran's HEU, end funding for proxies (Hamas/Hezbollah/Houthis), fully open Hormuz without toll
• Iran demands: frozen assets ($6B+), all sanctions lifted, continued Hormuz control, right to peaceful enrichment, end Israeli attacks on Lebanon, war reparations
• Araghchi on X: 'When just inches away from Islamabad MoU, we encountered maximalism, shifting goalposts, and blockade.'
• Ghalibaf taunted from Tehran: 'With so-called blockade, soon you'll be nostalgic for $4-$5 gas.'

THE BLOCKADE (Phase 2 Begins)
• CENTCOM: 'will begin implementing a blockade of all maritime traffic entering and exiting Iranian ports on April 13 at 10 AM ET.'
• Applied impartially to vessels of all nations entering/departing Iranian ports and coastal areas.
• Ships transiting Hormuz between non-Iranian ports: NOT impeded.
• US Navy to 'seek and interdict every vessel in International Waters that has paid a toll to Iran.'
• DOJ AG Blanche: 'will vigorously prosecute anyone who buys or sells sanctioned Iranian oil.'
• UK refuses to join — backs freedom of navigation. Gulf allies reportedly helping. Coalition of 40+ countries meeting separately.
• Iran IRGC: US military vessels in Hormuz 'will be considered ceasefire violation and met with severe force.'
• Columbia University's Karen Young: shortage of ~7M barrels crude + 4M barrels products daily. 'Elevated oil prices through end of 2026 for certain.'
• WSJ: Trump considering limited military strikes to break stalemate.

INDIA IMPACT (11 AM IST)
• Sensex: 75,868 intraday low (-1,700 pts / -2%). All 30 Sensex stocks fell.
• Nifty: 23,556 intraday low (-500 pts / -2%). Midcap 100 + Smallcap 100 also -2%.
• ₹8 LAKH CRORE wiped from BSE market cap (₹451L Cr to ₹443L Cr) in minutes.
• Rupee: 93.32/USD (-49 paise) — crude shock + FPI exodus.
• Worst performers: IndiGo -6.4%, Maruti -4.3%, L&T/Asian Paints/Bajaj Finance -3%+, HDFC Bank -2.5%, Reliance -2.6%, SBI -3%.
• OMCs BPCL/HPCL/IOC: -3-4%. Upstream ONGC/Oil India: positive.
• NSE launched Brent crude futures today — coincidental but timely.

WHAT COMES NEXT
• Vance left 'final and best offer' — diplomacy theoretically not dead.
• Ceasefire: Trump says 'holding well' but IRGC threatens US warships.
• Lebanon-Israel talks: Washington this Tuesday — separate diplomatic track.
• Saudi East-West Pipeline: partially offsets but cannot replace Hormuz at scale.
• India: 85%+ crude imports via Hormuz. 6-8 weeks fuel stock buffer. RBI rate 5.25%.
• Binary risks: Will blockade trigger Iranian military response? Will IRGC fire on US ships? Will Trump resume strikes?
• Morgan Stanley Sensex target: ₹95,000 Dec 2026 (IF deal). Emkay Nifty: 29,000 Mar 2027 (IF peace). Bear case: Nifty 55,000 / rupee 100+ / double-digit inflation.

VERDICT: Phase 2 — Blockade Era. Worst case (US-Iran naval combat) not yet activated. But every day of blockade with no breakthrough = oil prices firm higher, rupee weakens, inflation returns. The diplomacy window is narrow. Monitor IRGC response and any US strike resumption.
